# 🧠 Motor de Extracción y Estructuración de Conocimiento No Estructurado (KNEX) Producto completo que ingiere historiales de chat, correos y transcripciones masivas, extrae patrones técnicos, frameworks analíticos implícitos y terminología, y genera documentos formateados listos para portfolios, casos de estudio o manuales empresariales. --- ## 📦 Estructura del proyecto ``` knex/ ├── backend/ │ ├── main.py │ ├── ingestor.py │ ├── extractor.py │ ├── structurer.py │ ├── exporter.py │ ├── models.py │ └── requirements.txt ├── frontend/ │ ├── src/App.jsx │ ├── src/main.jsx │ ├── index.html │ ├── package.json │ └── vite.config.js ├── docker-compose.yml └── README.md ``` --- ## 🔧 Backend ### `backend/requirements.txt` ```txt fastapi==0.110.0 uvicorn[standard]==0.29.0 python-multipart==0.0.9 pydantic==2.6.4 openai==1.23.0 tiktoken==0.6.0 python-dotenv==1.0.1 httpx==0.27.0 chardet==5.2.0 beautifulsoup4==4.12.3 ``` ### `backend/models.py` ```python from __future__ import annotations from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional from enum import Enum class SourceType(str, Enum): CHAT_EXPORT = "chat_export" EMAIL = "email" TRANSCRIPT = "transcript" RAW_TEXT = "raw_text" class ExportFormat(str, Enum): MARKDOWN = "markdown" REACT_ARTIFACT = "react_artifact" JSON = "json" class ExtractedPattern(BaseModel): name: str = Field(..., description="Nombre del patrón detectado") category: str = Field(..., description="Categoría: técnico, metodológico, comunicacional") description: str evidence: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list) frequency: int = 1 relevance: float = Field(..., ge=0, le=1) class ExtractedFramework(BaseModel): name: str structure: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict) steps: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list) inferred_from: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list) abstraction_level: str = Field(..., description="táctico | estratégico | conceptual") class TerminologyEntry(BaseModel): term: str definition: str domain: str usage_examples: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list) is_jargon: bool = False class KnowledgeGraph(BaseModel): title: str summary: str patterns: List[ExtractedPattern] = Field(default_factory=list) frameworks: List[ExtractedFramework] = Field(default_factory=list) terminology: List[TerminologyEntry] = Field(default_factory=list) key_insights: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list) audience_suggestion: str = "" use_case_tags: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list) class ExtractionRequest(BaseModel): source_type: SourceType target_format: ExportFormat = ExportFormat.MARKDOWN language: str = "es" focus: Optional[str] = None # "técnico", "gestión", "pedagógico" max_tokens_context: int = 16000 class ExtractionResponse(BaseModel): graph: KnowledgeGraph artifact: str # Markdown o código React stats: Dict[str, Any] ``` ### `backend/ingestor.py` ```python """ Ingestor: normaliza fuentes heterogéneas a una representación uniforme de mensajes/turnos con metadatos. """ import re, json, csv, io, email from dataclasses import dataclass, field from typing import List, Optional from bs4 import BeautifulSoup @dataclass class Message: role: str # "user" | "assistant" | "system" | "human" content: str timestamp: Optional[str] = None author: Optional[str] = None meta: dict = field(default_factory=dict) # --- Detectores de formato ---------------------------------------------------- _WHATSAPP_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*\[?(\d{1,2}[/-]\d{1,2}[/-]\d{2,4}[,\s]+\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?(?:\s?[APap][Mm])?)\]?\s*[-–]?\s*([^:]+):\s*(.*)$") _SLACK_JSON_KEYS = {"user", "text", "ts"} _CSV_CHAT_KEYS = {"role", "content", "message", "author"} def detect_and_ingest(raw_text: str, filename: str = "") -> List[Message]: """Detecta el formato y devuelve mensajes normalizados.""" text = raw_text.strip() if not text: return [] # 1) JSON de Slack / export genérico if text.startswith("[") or text.startswith("{"): try: data = json.loads(text) return _ingest_json(data) except json.JSONDecodeError: pass # 2) CSV con columnas role/content if "\n" in text and ("," in text.splitlines()[0] or "\t" in text.splitlines()[0]): msgs = _try_csv(text) if msgs: return msgs # 3) Email RFC822 if text.lower().startswith(("from:", "received:", "return-path:")) or "\nfrom:" in text.lower()[:500]: return _ingest_email(text) # 4) Export WhatsApp / Telegram estilo "fecha - autor: texto" wa = _ingest_whatsapp_style(text) if wa: return wa # 5) Transcript con "User:" / "Assistant:" / "Human:" turn = _ingest_turn_based(text) if turn: return turn # 6) Fallback: un solo bloque de texto return [Message(role="user", content=text, author="source")] def _ingest_json(data) -> List[Message]: out: List[Message] = [] items = data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get("messages", [data]) for item in items: if not isinstance(item, dict): continue role = item.get("role") or item.get("speaker") or item.get("from") or "user" content = item.get("content") or item.get("text") or item.get("body") or "" if isinstance(content, list): # OpenAI multimodal content = " ".join( p.get("text", "") if isinstance(p, dict) else str(p) for p in content ) if not content: continue out.append(Message( role=str(role).lower(), content=str(content), timestamp=item.get("ts") or item.get("timestamp") or item.get("date"), author=item.get("user") or item.get("author") or item.get("name"), )) return out def _try_csv(text: str) -> List[Message]: try: sample = text[:2048] dialect = csv.Sniffer().sniff(sample, delimiters=",;\t|") reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text), dialect=dialect) if not reader.fieldnames: return [] lower = {f.lower() for f in reader.fieldnames} if not (_CSV_CHAT_KEYS & lower): return [] out = [] for row in reader: r = {k.lower(): v for k, v in row.items() if v} content = r.get("content") or r.get("message") or r.get("text") or "" role = r.get("role") or r.get("speaker") or "user" if content: out.append(Message(role=str(role).lower(), content=content, author=r.get("author") or r.get("user"))) return out except Exception: return [] def _ingest_email(text: str) -> List[Message]: try: msg = email.message_from_string(text) body = "" if msg.is_multipart(): for part in msg.walk(): if part.get_content_type() == "text/plain": payload = part.get_payload(decode=True) if payload: body = payload.decode(errors="ignore") break else: body = msg.get_payload(decode=True).decode(errors="ignore") if msg.get_payload() else "" soup = BeautifulSoup(body, "html.parser") clean = soup.get_text(separator="\n", strip=True) or body return [Message(role="user", content=clean, author=msg.get("From"), timestamp=msg.get("Date"), meta={"subject": msg.get("Subject")})] except Exception: return [] def _ingest_whatsapp_style(text: str) -> List[Message]: out = [] for line in text.splitlines(): m = _WHATSAPP_RE.match(line) if m: ts, author, content = m.groups() out.append(Message(role="user", content=content.strip(), timestamp=ts.strip(), author=author.strip())) return out def _ingest_turn_based(text: str) -> List[Message]: turn_re = re.compile(r"^(User|Assistant|Human|AI|System|Bot|Me)\s*:\s*(.*)$", re.IGNORECASE) out = [] current_role, current_buf = None, [] for line in text.splitlines(): m = turn_re.match(line.strip()) if m: if current_role is not None: out.append(Message(role=current_role, content="\n".join(current_buf).strip())) current_role = m.group(1).lower() if current_role in {"human", "me"}: current_role = "user" if current_role == "bot": current_role = "assistant" current_buf = [m.group(2)] else: if current_role is not None: current_buf.append(line) if current_role is not None and current_buf: out.append(Message(role=current_role, content="\n".join(current_buf).strip())) return out def render_for_llm(messages: List[Message], max_tokens: int = 16000) -> str: """Renderiza los mensajes en un bloque compacto para el LLM.""" import tiktoken enc = tiktoken.encoding_for_model("gpt-4o-mini") buf = [] total = 0 for m in messages: line = f"[{m.author or m.role}] {m.content}".strip() n = len(enc.encode(line)) if total + n > max_tokens: buf.append(f"... (truncado, {len(messages)-len(buf)} mensajes restantes) ...") break buf.append(line) total += n return "\n\n".join(buf) ``` ### `backend/extractor.py` ```python """ Extractor: utiliza un LLM compatible con OpenAI para identificar patrones, frameworks implícitos y terminología a partir de texto no estructurado. """ import os, json from typing import List from openai import OpenAI from models import ( KnowledgeGraph, ExtractedPattern, ExtractedFramework, TerminologyEntry, ) SYSTEM_PROMPT = """Eres un analista experto en ingeniería del conocimiento. A partir de una conversación o texto no estructurado debes identificar: 1) PATRONES técnicos, metodológicos o comunicacionales recurrentes. 2) FRAMEWORKS analíticos IMPLÍCITOS: esquemas de razonamiento que el autor aplica sin nombrarlos (por ejemplo: "análisis costo-beneficio", "pirámide de abstracción", "diagnóstico → hipótesis → validación"). 3) TERMINOLOGÍA específica del dominio, con definiciones precisas. 4) INSIGHTS clave reutilizables. Debes ser CONCRETO, citar evidencia textual corta entre comillas, y evitar inventar. Si no hay suficiente información para una categoría, devuelve []. Responde SIEMPRE en JSON válido con esta forma: { "title": "...", "summary": "...", "patterns": [{"name":"","category":"","description":"","evidence":[""],"frequency":1,"relevance":0.0}], "frameworks": [{"name":"","structure":{},"steps":[],"inferred_from":[""],"abstraction_level":""}], "terminology": [{"term":"","definition":"","domain":"","usage_examples":[],"is_jargon":false}], "key_insights": [], "audience_suggestion": "", "use_case_tags": [] } """ def _build_client() -> OpenAI: return OpenAI( api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "sk-placeholder"), base_url=os.getenv("OPENAI_BASE_URL"), # permite Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM, etc. ) def extract(text: str, focus: str | None, language: str = "es", model: str | None = None) -> KnowledgeGraph: client = _build_client() model = model or os.getenv("KNEX_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini") focus_hint = f"\nFoco solicitado por el usuario: {focus}." if focus else "" user_msg = ( f"Idioma de salida: {language}.{focus_hint}\n\n" f"=== TEXTO A ANALIZAR ===\n{text}\n=== FIN ===" ) resp = client.chat.completions.create( model=model, messages=[ {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT}, {"role": "user", "content": user_msg}, ], temperature=0.2, response_format={"type": "json_object"}, ) raw = resp.choices[0].message.content or "{}" data = json.loads(raw) return KnowledgeGraph( title=data.get("title", "Sin título"), summary=data.get("summary", ""), patterns=[ExtractedPattern(**p) for p in data.get("patterns", [])], frameworks=[ExtractedFramework(**f) for f in data.get("frameworks", [])], terminology=[TerminologyEntry(**t) for t in data.get("terminology", [])], key_insights=data.get("key_insights", []), audience_suggestion=data.get("audience_suggestion", ""), use_case_tags=data.get("use_case_tags", []), ) ``` ### `backend/structurer.py` ```python """ Structurer: organiza el KnowledgeGraph en secciones narrativas según el tipo de documento objetivo (caso de estudio, portfolio, manual). """ from models import KnowledgeGraph def structure_for(graph: KnowledgeGraph, doc_type: str = "case_study") -> dict: """Devuelve un esqueleto con secciones ordenadas y contenido.""" sections = [] # 1) Resumen ejecutivo sections.append({ "heading": "Resumen ejecutivo", "level": 1, "body": graph.summary, }) # 2) Insights clave if graph.key_insights: sections.append({ "heading": "Insights clave", "level": 2, "body": "\n".join(f"- {i}" for i in graph.key_insights), }) # 3) Marcos analíticos implícitos if graph.frameworks: body = [] for f in graph.frameworks: body.append(f"### {f.name} _(nivel: {f.abstraction_level})_") if f.steps: body.append("**Pasos:**") body.extend(f"{i+1}. {s}" for i, s in enumerate(f.steps)) if f.structure: body.append(f"**Estructura:** `{f.structure}`") if f.inferred_from: body.append("**Evidencia:** " + "; ".join(f'"{e}"' for e in f.inferred_from)) body.append("") sections.append({"heading": "Marcos analíticos implícitos", "level": 2, "body": "\n".join(body)}) # 4) Patrones if graph.patterns: body = [] for p in sorted(graph.patterns, key=lambda x: -x.relevance): body.append(f"- **{p.name}** _({p.category})_ — {p.description}") if p.evidence: body.append(" - Evidencia: " + "; ".join(f'"{e}"' for e in p.evidence[:3])) sections.append({"heading": "Patrones detectados", "level": 2, "body": "\n".join(body)}) # 5) Glosario / terminología if graph.terminology: body = [] for t in graph.terminology: tag = " `jerga`" if t.is_jargon else "" body.append(f"- **{t.term}**{tag} ({t.domain}): {t.definition}") if t.usage_examples: body.append(f" - Uso: " + " | ".join(f'"{e}"' for e in t.usage_examples[:2])) sections.append({"heading": "Terminología y glosario", "level": 2, "body": "\n".join(body)}) # 6) Audiencia y tags sections.append({ "heading": "Audiencia y aplicabilidad", "level": 2, "body": ( f"**Audiencia sugerida:** {graph.audience_suggestion or 'no especificada'}\n\n" f"**Tags de caso de uso:** {', '.join(graph.use_case_tags) or '—'}" ), }) return {"title": graph.title, "sections": sections} ``` ### `backend/exporter.py` ```python """ Exporter: genera los artefactos finales (Markdown, React artifact, JSON). """ from models import KnowledgeGraph, ExportFormat from structurer import structure_for # ---------------------- Markdown ---------------------------------------------- def to_markdown(graph: KnowledgeGraph, doc_type: str = "case_study") -> str: s = structure_for(graph, doc_type) lines = [f"# {s['title']}", ""] for sec in s["sections"]: prefix = "#" * (sec["level"] + 1) lines.append(f"{prefix} {sec['heading']}") lines.append("") lines.append(sec["body"]) lines.append("") lines.append("---") lines.append("_Generado por KNEX · Motor de Extracción de Conocimiento No Estructurado_") return "\n".join(lines) # ---------------------- React Artifact ---------------------------------------- _REACT_TEMPLATE = """import React from "react"; const data = __DATA_JSON__; const badge = (color) => ({ display: "inline-block", padding: "2px 8px", borderRadius: 999, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600, background: color, color: "#0b1020", marginRight: 6, }); const Card = ({title, children}) => (

{data.key_insights?.length > 0 && (

{f.name}{" "} {f.abstraction_level}
{f.steps?.length>0 && (
    {f.steps.map((s,j)=>(

    2. ))}

Evidencia: {f.inferred_from.map(x=>`"${x}"`).join(" · ")}
)}
))} )} {data.patterns?.length > 0 && ( {data.patterns.map((p,i)=>(
{p.name}{" "} {p.category} relevancia {Math.round(p.relevance*100)}%
{p.description}
))} )} {data.terminology?.length > 0 && (

Audiencia: {data.audience_suggestion || "—"} · Tags: {(data.use_case_tags||[]).join(", ") || "—"}
); } """ def to_react_artifact(graph: KnowledgeGraph) -> str: import json payload = json.dumps(graph.model_dump(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) return _REACT_TEMPLATE.replace("__DATA_JSON__", payload) # ---------------------- Dispatcher -------------------------------------------- def export(graph: KnowledgeGraph, fmt: ExportFormat, doc_type: str = "case_study") -> str: if fmt == ExportFormat.MARKDOWN: return to_markdown(graph, doc_type) if fmt == ExportFormat.REACT_ARTIFACT: return to_react_artifact(graph) if fmt == ExportFormat.JSON: import json return json.dumps(graph.model_dump(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) raise ValueError(f"Formato no soportado: {fmt}") ``` ### `backend/main.py` ```python """ KNEX API · Motor de Extracción y Estructuración de Conocimiento No Estructurado """ import os, time from pathlib import Path from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, File, Form, HTTPException from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware from fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, JSONResponse from dotenv import load_dotenv from models import SourceType, ExportFormat, ExtractionResponse from ingestor import detect_and_ingest, render_for_llm from extractor import extract from exporter import export load_dotenv() app = FastAPI(title="KNEX", version="1.0.0") app.add_middleware( CORSMiddleware, allow_origins=["*"], allow_methods=["*"], allow_headers=["*"], ) @app.get("/health") def health(): return {"ok": True, "model": os.getenv("KNEX_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini")} @app.post("/extract", response_model=ExtractionResponse) async def extract_endpoint( file: UploadFile = File(...), source_type: SourceType = Form(SourceType.RAW_TEXT), target_format: ExportFormat = Form(ExportFormat.MARKDOWN), language: str = Form("es"), focus: str | None = Form(None), max_tokens_context: int = Form(16000), ): t0 = time.time() raw = await file.read() # Detectar encoding try: text = raw.decode("utf-8") except UnicodeDecodeError: import chardet enc = chardet.detect(raw).get("encoding") or "latin-1" text = raw.decode(enc, errors="ignore") messages = detect_and_ingest(text, filename=file.filename or "") if not messages: raise HTTPException(400, "No se pudo interpretar el contenido del archivo.") context = render_for_llm(messages, max_tokens=max_tokens_context) graph = extract(context, focus=focus, language=language) artifact = export(graph, target_format) return ExtractionResponse( graph=graph, artifact=artifact, stats={ "messages_parsed": len(messages), "chars_ingested": len(text), "chars_context": len(context), "patterns": len(graph.patterns), "frameworks": len(graph.frameworks), "terms": len(graph.terminology), "elapsed_seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 2), }, ) @app.post("/preview") async def preview_endpoint(file: UploadFile = File(...), max_tokens_context: int = Form(4000)): """Devuelve los mensajes parseados (sin LLM) para validar ingestión.""" raw = await file.read() try: text = raw.decode("utf-8") except UnicodeDecodeError: text = raw.decode("latin-1", errors="ignore") messages = detect_and_ingest(text, filename=file.filename or "") return { "messages_count": len(messages), "preview": [ {"role": m.role, "author": m.author, "timestamp": m.timestamp, "snippet": m.content[:240]} for m in messages[:50] ], "context": render_for_llm(messages, max_tokens=max_tokens_context), } @app.get("/export/{fmt}") def export_sample(fmt: str): """Endpoint de demostración con un KnowledgeGraph de ejemplo.""" from models import (KnowledgeGraph, ExtractedPattern, ExtractedFramework, TerminologyEntry) sample = KnowledgeGraph( title="Demo: Revisión de arquitectura de pagos", summary="Conversación técnica donde se aplican principios de diseño evolutivo.", patterns=[ ExtractedPattern(name="Strangler Fig", category="técnico", description="Reemplazo incremental de un sistema legado.", evidence=["'lo vamos a ir migrando por bordes'"], frequency=3, relevance=0.9), ], frameworks=[ ExtractedFramework(name="Diagnóstico → Hipótesis → Validación", structure={"phases": 3}, steps=["Diagnosticar","Hipótesis","Validar"], inferred_from=["'antes de tocar nada midamos'"], abstraction_level="estratégico"), ], terminology=[ TerminologyEntry(term="Bounded context", definition="Frontera semántica de un modelo.", domain="DDD", usage_examples=["'cada servicio es su propio BC'"], is_jargon=True), ], key_insights=["Migrar por bordes reduce riesgo sistémico."], audience_suggestion="Arquitectos de software y tech leads", use_case_tags=["caso_de_estudio", "portfolio", "arquitectura"], ) artifact = export(sample, ExportFormat(fmt)) if fmt == "json": return JSONResponse(content=__import__("json").loads(artifact)) return PlainTextResponse(artifact) ``` ### Arranque del backend ```bash cd backend python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate pip install -r requirements.txt # Configura tus claves en backend/.env: # OPENAI_API_KEY=... # OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.openai.com/v1 # o Groq / OpenRouter / Ollama # KNEX_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000 ``` --- ## 🎨 Frontend """
text_chunker.py — Segmentación inteligente de texto largo
"""
import re
import hashlib
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from config import settings


@dataclass
class TextChunk:
    id: int
    content: str
    start_index: int
    end_index: int
    token_count: int
    metadata: Dict[str, Any]

    @property
    def content_hash(self) -> str:
        return hashlib.md5(self.content.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]


class IntelligentTextChunker:
    """
    Segmentador que respeta límites semánticos: párrafos,
    secciones, mensajes de chat y bloques de código.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        chunk_size: int = settings.CHUNK_SIZE,
        overlap: int = settings.CHUNK_OVERLAP
    ):
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size
        self.overlap = overlap
        self._section_patterns = [
            r'^#{1,6}\s+',          # Markdown headers
            r'^[A-Z][A-Z\s]{3,}:',  # ALL CAPS sections
            r'^\d+[\.\)]\s+',       # Numbered sections
            r'^---+$',              # Horizontal rules
            r'^\*\*\*+$',           # Bold separators
        ]

    def chunk_text(self, text: str, metadata: Optional[Dict] = None) -> List[TextChunk]:
        """Segmenta texto respetando límites semánticos"""
        if not text or not text.strip():
            return []

        # Pre-limpieza
        text = self._normalize_whitespace(text)

        # Dividir en unidades semánticas
        semantic_units = self._split_into_semantic_units(text)

        # Construir chunks respetando límites
        chunks = []
        current_chunk_parts = []
        current_length = 0
        chunk_index = 0

        for unit in semantic_units:
            unit_len = len(unit)

            # Si una unidad sola excede el tamaño, forzar división
            if unit_len > self.chunk_size:
                # Guardar lo acumulado primero
                if current_chunk_parts:
                    chunks.append(self._build_chunk(
                        chunk_index, current_chunk_parts, current_length,
                        metadata or {}
                    ))
                    chunk_index += 1
                    current_chunk_parts = []
                    current_length = 0

                # Dividir la unidad grande
                sub_chunks = self._force_split(unit, self.chunk_size)
                for sub in sub_chunks:
                    chunks.append(TextChunk(
                        id=chunk_index,
                        content=sub,
                        start_index=text.find(sub[:50]) if len(sub) > 50 else text.find(sub),
                        end_index=0,
                        token_count=self._estimate_tokens(sub),
                        metadata={**(metadata or {}), "force_split": True}
                    ))
                    chunk_index += 1
                continue

            # Si agregar esta unidad excede el límite
            if current_length + unit_len > self.chunk_size and current_chunk_parts:
                chunks.append(self._build_chunk(
                    chunk_index, current_chunk_parts, current_length,
                    metadata or {}
                ))
                chunk_index += 1

                # Aplicar overlap: mantener últimas partes
                overlap_parts = self._get_overlap_parts(current_chunk_parts)
                current_chunk_parts = overlap_parts
                current_length = sum(len(p) for p in overlap_parts)

            current_chunk_parts.append(unit)
            current_length += unit_len

        # Último chunk
        if current_chunk_parts:
            chunks.append(self._build_chunk(
                chunk_index, current_chunk_parts, current_length,
                metadata or {}
            ))

        return chunks

    def chunk_chat_messages(self, messages: List[Dict]) -> List[TextChunk]:
        """Segmenta mensajes de chat agrupándolos por contexto"""
        chunks = []
        current_messages = []
        current_length = 0
        chunk_index = 0

        for msg in messages:
            msg_text = f"[{msg.get('role', 'user')}]: {msg.get('content', '')}"
            msg_len = len(msg_text)

            if current_length + msg_len > self.chunk_size and current_messages:
                content = "\n\n".join(current_messages)
                chunks.append(TextChunk(
                    id=chunk_index,
                    content=content,
                    start_index=0,
                    end_index=len(content),
                    token_count=self._estimate_tokens(content),
                    metadata={
                        "type": "chat",
                        "message_count": len(current_messages),
                        "roles": list(set(
                            m.split("]:")[0].strip("[").strip()
                            for m in current_messages
                        ))
                    }
                ))
                chunk_index += 1

                # Overlap: mantener últimos 2 mensajes
                keep = min(2, len(current_messages))
                current_messages = current_messages[-keep:]
                current_length = sum(len(m) for m in current_messages)

            current_messages.append(msg_text)
            current_length += msg_len

        if current_messages:
            content = "\n\n".join(current_messages)
            chunks.append(TextChunk(
                id=chunk_index,
                content=content,
                start_index=0,
                end_index=len(content),
                token_count=self._estimate_tokens(content),
                metadata={"type": "chat", "message_count": len(current_messages)}
            ))

        return chunks

    def _split_into_semantic_units(self, text: str) -> List[str]:
        """Divide texto en unidades semánticas (párrafos/secciones)"""
        # Primero intentar por párrafos dobles
        paragraphs = re.split(r'\n\s*\n', text)
        units = []

        for para in paragraphs:
            para = para.strip()
            if not para:
                continue

            # Si el párrafo es pequeño, mantenerlo
            if len(para) <= self.chunk_size // 2:
                units.append(para)
            else:
                # Dividir por oraciones
                sentences = self._split_sentences(para)
                units.extend(sentences)

        return units

    def _split_sentences(self, text: str) -> List[str]:
        """Divide en oraciones respetando abreviaturas"""
        # Regex mejorado para oraciones
        pattern = r'(?<=[.!?])\s+(?=[A-ZÁÉÍÓÚ])'
        sentences = re.split(pattern, text)
        return [s.strip() for s in sentences if s.strip()]

    def _force_split(self, text: str, max_size: int) -> List[str]:
        """Fuerza división de texto muy largo por oraciones"""
        sentences = self._split_sentences(text)
        parts = []
        current = []
        current_len = 0

        for sentence in sentences:
            if current_len + len(sentence) > max_size and current:
                parts.append(" ".join(current))
                current = []
                current_len = 0
            current.append(sentence)
            current_len += len(sentence)

        if current:
            parts.append(" ".join(current))

        # Si aún hay partes muy grandes, dividir por caracteres
        final_parts = []
        for part in parts:
            if len(part) > max_size:
                for i in range(0, len(part), max_size - self.overlap):
                    final_parts.append(part[i:i + max_size])
            else:
                final_parts.append(part)

        return final_parts

    def _get_overlap_parts(self, parts: List[str]) -> List[str]:
        """Obtiene las últimas partes para overlap"""
        overlap_text = ""
        result = []
        for part in reversed(parts):
            if len(overlap_text) + len(part) <= self.overlap:
                result.insert(0, part)
                overlap_text = part + " " + overlap_text
            else:
                break
        return result

    def _build_chunk(self, index: int, parts: List[str], length: int,
                     metadata: Dict) -> TextChunk:
        content = "\n\n".join(parts)
        return TextChunk(
            id=index,
            content=content,
            start_index=0,
            end_index=len(content),
            token_count=self._estimate_tokens(content),
            metadata={**metadata, "parts_count": len(parts)}
        )

    def _normalize_whitespace(self, text: str) -> str:
        """Normaliza espacios en blanco"""
        text = re.sub(r'[ \t]+', ' ', text)
        text = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', text)
        return text.strip()

    def _estimate_tokens(self, text: str) -> int:
        """Estimación rápida de tokens (~4 chars por token)"""
        return max(1, len(text) // 4)

"""

import json
import csv
import io
import zipfile
import email
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Tuple, Optional

class FileParser:
    """Parser unificado para múltiples formatos"""

    SUPPORTED_FORMATS = {
        ".txt": "text",
        ".md": "markdown",
        ".pdf": "pdf",
        ".docx": "docx",
        ".csv": "csv",
        ".json": "json",
        ".jsonl": "jsonl",
        ".html": "html",
        ".eml": "email",
        ".mbox": "mbox",
        ".zip": "archive",
    }

    @classmethod
    async def parse_file(cls, file_path: str,
                         content_type: Optional[str] = None) -> Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Parsea un archivo y devuelve (texto, metadata)"""
        path = Path(file_path)
        ext = path.suffix.lower()

        if ext not in cls.SUPPORTED_FORMATS:
            raise ValueError(f"Formato no soportado: {ext}")

        parser_name = cls.SUPPORTED_FORMATS[ext]
        parser = getattr(cls, f"_parse_{parser_name}")

        return await parser(file_path)

    @classmethod
    async def parse_bytes(cls, data: bytes, filename: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Parsea bytes de archivo"""
        ext = Path(filename).suffix.lower()
        if ext == ".txt" or ext == ".md":
            text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            return text, {"format": ext, "filename": filename}
        elif ext == ".json":
            text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            parsed = json.loads(text)
            return json.dumps(parsed, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), {
                "format": "json", "filename": filename
            }
        elif ext == ".csv":
            text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            return text, {"format": "csv", "filename": filename}
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Parseo desde bytes no soportado para {ext}")

    @classmethod
    async def _parse_text(cls, file_path: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict]:
        with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            content = f.read()
        return content, {"format": "text", "file": file_path}

    @classmethod
    async def _parse_markdown(cls, file_path: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict]:
        with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            content = f.read()
        return content, {"format": "markdown", "file": file_path}

    @classmethod
    async def _parse_pdf(cls, file_path: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict]:
        from PyPDF2 import PdfReader
        reader = PdfReader(file_path)
        pages = []
        for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
            text = page.extract_text() or ""
            if text.strip():
                pages.append(f"--- Página {i + 1} ---\n{text}")

        content = "\n\n".join(pages)
        metadata = {
            "format": "pdf",
            "file": file_path,
            "page_count": len(reader.pages),
            "pdf_metadata": dict(reader.metadata) if reader.metadata else {}
        }
        return content, metadata

    @classmethod
    async def _parse_docx(cls, file_path: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict]:
        from docx import Document
        doc = Document(file_path)
        paragraphs = [p.text for p in doc.paragraphs if p.text.strip()]

        # Extraer tablas
        tables_text = []
        for table in doc.tables:
            rows = []
            for row in table.rows:
                cells = [cell.text.strip() for cell in row.cells]
                rows.append(" | ".join(cells))
            if rows:
                tables_text.append("\n".join(rows))

        content = "\n\n".join(paragraphs)
        if tables_text:
            content += "\n\n--- Tablas ---\n\n" + "\n\n".join(tables_text)

        return content, {"format": "docx", "file": file_path}

    @classmethod
    async def _parse_csv(cls, file_path: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict]:
        with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            reader = csv.reader(f)
            rows = list(reader)

        if not rows:
            return "", {"format": "csv", "row_count": 0}

        headers = rows[0]
        content_lines = [" | ".join(headers)]
        content_lines.append("-" * len(content_lines[0]))

        for row in rows[1:]:
            content_lines.append(" | ".join(row))

        content = "\n".join(content_lines)
        return content, {"format": "csv", "row_count": len(rows), "columns": headers}

    @classmethod
    async def _parse_json(cls, file_path: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict]:
        with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            data = json.load(f)

        if isinstance(data, list):
            # Array de objetos (ej: historial de chat)
            parts = []
            for item in data:
                if isinstance(item, dict):
                    parts.append(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
                else:
                    parts.append(str(item))
            content = "\n\n---\n\n".join(parts)
        else:
            content = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

        return content, {"format": "json", "file": file_path}

    @classmethod
    async def _parse_jsonl(cls, file_path: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict]:
        entries = []
        with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line:
                    try:
                        obj = json.loads(line)
                        entries.append(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False))
                    except json.JSONDecodeError:
                        entries.append(line)

        content = "\n\n".join(entries)
        return content, {"format": "jsonl", "entry_count": len(entries)}

    @classmethod
    async def _parse_html(cls, file_path: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict]:
        from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
        with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            html = f.read()

        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")

        # Remover scripts y estilos
        for tag in soup(["script", "style", "nav", "footer", "header"]):
            tag.decompose()

        text = soup.get_text(separator="\n", strip=True)
        title = soup.title.string if soup.title else ""

        return text, {"format": "html", "title": title, "file": file_path}

    @classmethod
    async def _parse_email(cls, file_path: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict]:
        with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
            msg = email.message_from_bytes(f.read())

        subject = msg.get("Subject", "")
        from_addr = msg.get("From", "")
        to_addr = msg.get("To", "")
        date = msg.get("Date", "")

        body = ""
        if msg.is_multipart():
            for part in msg.walk():
                content_type = part.get_content_type()
                if content_type == "text/plain":
                    payload = part.get_payload(decode=True)
                    if payload:
                        charset = part.get_content_charset() or "utf-8"
                        body = payload.decode(charset, errors="replace")
                        break
        else:
            payload = msg.get_payload(decode=True)
            if payload:
                charset = msg.get_content_charset() or "utf-8"
                body = payload.decode(charset, errors="replace")

        content = (
            f"Asunto: {subject}\n"
            f"De: {from_addr}\n"
            f"Para: {to_addr}\n"
            f"Fecha: {date}\n\n"
            f"{body}"
        )

        return content, {
            "format": "email", "subject": subject,
            "from": from_addr, "to": to_addr, "date": date
        }

    @classmethod
    async def _parse_mbox(cls, file_path: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict]:
        import mailbox
        mbox = mailbox.mbox(file_path)
        emails = []

        for msg in mbox:
            subject = msg.get("Subject", "")
            from_addr = msg.get("From", "")
            body = ""

            if msg.is_multipart():
                for part in msg.walk():
                    if part.get_content_type() == "text/plain":
                        payload = part.get_payload(decode=True)
                        if payload:
                            body = payload.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                            break
            else:
                payload = msg.get_payload(decode=True)
                if payload:
                    body = payload.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

            emails.append(f"=== {subject} (De: {from_addr}) ===\n{body}")

        content = "\n\n" + "=" * 60 + "\n\n".join(emails)
        return content, {"format": "mbox", "email_count": len(emails)}

    @classmethod
    async def _parse_archive(cls, file_path: str) -> Tuple[str, Dict]:
        """Parsea archivos dentro de un ZIP"""
        all_content = []
        file_count = 0

        with zipfile.ZipFile(file_path, "r") as zf:
            for name in zf.namelist():
                if name.endswith("/"):
                    continue
                ext = Path(name).suffix.lower()
                if ext in cls.SUPPORTED_FORMATS and ext != ".zip":
                    try:
                        data = zf.read(name)
                        text, meta = await cls.parse_bytes(data, name)
                        if text.strip():
                            all_content.append(
                                f"=== Archivo: {name} ===\n{text}"
                            )
                            file_count += 1
                    except Exception:
                        continue

        content = "\n\n".join(all_content)
        return content, {"format": "archive", "files_parsed": file_count}

    Gestiona la ingesta de datos desde múltiples fuentes,

    """

        self.chunker = IntelligentTextChunker()

    async def ingest_from_text(
        self,
        text_input: RawTextInput,
        request: ExtractionRequest
    ) -> Tuple[List[TextChunk], Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Ingesta desde texto crudo"""
        content = text_input.content
        metadata = {
            "source": "raw_text",
            "input_length": len(content),
            **(text_input.metadata or {})
        }

        # Normalizar
        content = self._normalize_content(content, request.source_type)

        # Segmentar
        chunks = self.chunker.chunk_text(content, metadata)

        stats = {
            "original_length": len(text_input.content),
            "normalized_length": len(content),
            "chunk_count": len(chunks),
            "estimated_tokens": sum(c.token_count for c in chunks),
            "compression_ratio": len(content) / max(1, len(text_input.content))
        }

        return chunks, stats

    async def ingest_from_chat(
        self,
        chat_input: ChatHistoryInput,
        request: ExtractionRequest
    ) -> Tuple[List[TextChunk], Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Ingesta desde historial de chat"""
        messages = [msg.dict() for msg in chat_input.messages]

        # Enriquecer mensajes con contexto temporal
        enriched_messages = self._enrich_chat_messages(messages)

        # Segmentar como chat
        chunks = self.chunker.chunk_chat_messages(enriched_messages)

        # Agregar metadata de chat
        for chunk in chunks:
            chunk.metadata.update({
                "source": "chat",
                "platform": chat_input.platform,
                "session_id": chat_input.session_id
            })

        stats = {
            "message_count": len(messages),
            "unique_senders": len(set(m.get("role", "unknown") for m in messages)),
            "chunk_count": len(chunks),
            "estimated_tokens": sum(c.token_count for c in chunks),
            "platform": chat_input.platform
        }

        return chunks, stats

    async def ingest_from_file(
        self,
        file_path: str,
        request: ExtractionRequest
    ) -> Tuple[List[TextChunk], Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Ingesta desde archivo"""
        content, file_metadata = await self.parser.parse_file(file_path)

        if not content.strip():
            raise ValueError("El archivo no contiene texto extraíble")

        metadata = {
            "source": "file",
            "file_path": file_path,
            **file_metadata
        }

        # Detectar si es formato de chat (JSON con mensajes)
        if file_metadata.get("format") == "json":
            try:
                import json
                data = json.loads(content)
                if isinstance(data, list) and data and "role" in data[0]:
                    chunks = self.chunker.chunk_chat_messages(data)
                    stats = {
                        "format": "chat_json",
                        "message_count": len(data),
                        "chunk_count": len(chunks)
                    }
                    return chunks, stats
            except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, IndexError):
                pass

        # Segmentación estándar
        chunks = self.chunker.chunk_text(content, metadata)

        stats = {
            "file_format": file_metadata.get("format"),
            "content_length": len(content),
            "chunk_count": len(chunks),
            "estimated_tokens": sum(c.token_count for c in chunks),
            **{k: v for k, v in file_metadata.items() if k != "format"}
        }

        return chunks, stats

    async def ingest_from_upload(
        self,
        file_content: bytes,
        filename: str,
        request: ExtractionRequest
    ) -> Tuple[List[TextChunk], Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Ingesta desde archivo subido"""
        content, file_metadata = await self.parser.parse_bytes(file_content, filename)

        metadata = {
            "source": "upload",
            "filename": filename,
            **file_metadata
        }

        chunks = self.chunker.chunk_text(content, metadata)

        stats = {
            "filename": filename,
            "file_size_bytes": len(file_content),
            "content_length": len(content),
            "chunk_count": len(chunks),
            "estimated_tokens": sum(c.token_count for c in chunks)
        }

        return chunks, stats

    def _normalize_content(self, content: str, source_type: SourceType) -> str:
        """Normaliza contenido según tipo de fuente"""
        import re

        # Remover caracteres de control excepto newlines
        content = re.sub(r'[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]', '', content)

        # Normalizar saltos de línea
        content = content.replace('\r\n', '\n').replace('\r', '\n')

        # Remover líneas vacías excesivas
        content = re.sub(r'\n{4,}', '\n\n\n', content)

        # Normalización específica por tipo
        if source_type == SourceType.CHAT_HISTORY:
            # Intentar normalizar formatos comunes de chat
            content = self._normalize_chat_format(content)
        elif source_type == SourceType.EMAIL:
            content = self._normalize_email_format(content)

        return content.strip()

    def _normalize_chat_format(self, content: str) -> str:
        """Normaliza diferentes formatos de exportación de chat"""
        import re

        # WhatsApp: [DD/MM/YY, HH:MM:SS] Nombre: mensaje
        whatsapp_pattern = r'\[\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{2,4},?\s*\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?\]\s*'
        content = re.sub(whatsapp_pattern, '', content)

        # Slack: Nombre  HH:MM AM/PM\nmensaje
        slack_pattern = r'^(\w+)\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}\s*(?:AM|PM)\s*\n'
        content = re.sub(slack_pattern, r'[\1]: ', content, flags=re.MULTILINE)

        # Discord: [DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM] Nombre: mensaje
        discord_pattern = r'\[\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{4}\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}\]\s*'
        content = re.sub(discord_pattern, '', content)

        return content

    def _normalize_email_format(self, content: str) -> str:
        """Normaliza formato de email"""
        import re
        # Remover headers repetidos de hilos
        content = re.sub(
            r'(?:On .+ wrote:\s*\n(?:>.*\n)+)',
            '\n[Respuesta anterior omitida]\n',
            content
        )
        return content

    def _enrich_chat_messages(self, messages: List[Dict]) -> List[Dict]:
        """Enriquece mensajes con contexto adicional"""
        enriched = []
        for i, msg in enumerate(messages):
            enriched_msg = {**msg}
            enriched_msg["message_index"] = i
            enriched_msg["content_length"] = len(msg.get("content", ""))

            # Detectar si contiene código
            content = msg.get("content", "")
            if "```" in content or "def " in content or "function " in content:
                enriched_msg["contains_code"] = True

            # Detectar preguntas
            if "?" in content:
                enriched_msg["is_question"] = True

            enriched.append(enriched_msg)

        return enriched

    def compute_content_hash(self, content: str) -> str:
        """Hash para deduplicación"""
        return hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]

    FRAMEWORK_EXTRACTION_PROMPT = """Identifica frameworks analíticos y metodologías implícitas o explícitas en el texto.

Un framework puede ser:

Para cada framework, extrae:

TEXTO A ANALIZAR:
{chunk_content}

Devuelve JSON: {{"frameworks": [...]}}"""

Para cada término:

TEXTO A ANALIZAR:

Devuelve JSON: {{"terminology": [...]}}"""

TEXTO COMPLETO (resumen de chunks):

Devuelve JSON: {{"clusters": [...]}}"""

    def __init__(self, llm_client: LLMClient):
        self.llm = llm_client
        self._initialized = False

    async def initialize(self):
        await self.llm.initialize()
        self._initialized = True

    async def extract_from_chunks(
        self,
        chunks: List[TextChunk],
        request: ExtractionRequest,
        progress_callback=None
    ) -> ExtractionResult:
        """
        Pipeline completo de extracción sobre chunks de texto
        """
        start_time = time.time()
        extraction_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

        all_patterns = []
        all_frameworks = []
        all_terminology = []

        # ── Fase 1: Extracción paralela por chunk ──
        if progress_callback:
            await progress_callback(ExtractionStatus.EXTRACTING, 0)

        batch_size = 3
        total_batches = (len(chunks) + batch_size - 1) // batch_size

        for batch_idx in range(0, len(chunks), batch_size):
            batch = chunks[batch_idx:batch_idx + batch_size]

            # Crear tareas para cada chunk en el batch
            tasks = []
            for chunk in batch:
                chunk_tasks = []

                if request.extract_patterns:
                    chunk_tasks.append(
                        self._extract_patterns(chunk.content)
                    )
                if request.extract_frameworks:
                    chunk_tasks.append(
                        self._extract_frameworks(chunk.content)
                    )
                if request.extract_terminology:
                    chunk_tasks.append(
                        self._extract_terminology(chunk.content)
                    )

                if chunk_tasks:
                    tasks.append(asyncio.gather(*chunk_tasks))

            # Ejecutar batch
            batch_results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)

            # Procesar resultados del batch
            for result_group in batch_results:
                if isinstance(result_group, Exception):
                    continue
                for result in result_group:
                    if isinstance(result, Exception):
                        continue
                    if "patterns" in result:
                        all_patterns.extend(result["patterns"])
                    if "frameworks" in result:
                        all_frameworks.extend(result["frameworks"])
                    if "terminology" in result:
                        all_terminology.extend(result["terminology"])

            if progress_callback:
                progress = int(((batch_idx + batch_size) / len(chunks)) * 60)
                await progress_callback(ExtractionStatus.EXTRACTING, min(progress, 60))

        # ── Fase 2: Deduplicación y consolidación ──
        if progress_callback:
            await progress_callback(ExtractionStatus.ANALYZING, 65)

        consolidated_patterns = self._deduplicate_patterns(all_patterns)
        consolidated_frameworks = self._deduplicate_frameworks(all_frameworks)
        consolidated_terminology = self._deduplicate_terminology(all_terminology)

        # ── Fase 3: Análisis de clusters temáticos ──
        if progress_callback:
            await progress_callback(ExtractionStatus.ANALYZING, 75)

        clusters = await self._extract_knowledge_clusters(chunks)

        # ── Fase 4: Generar resumen ejecutivo ──
        if progress_callback:
            await progress_callback(ExtractionStatus.ANALYZING, 85)

        summary_data = await self._generate_executive_summary(
            chunks, consolidated_patterns, consolidated_frameworks,
            consolidated_terminology, clusters, request
        )

        processing_time = time.time() - start_time

        if progress_callback:
            await progress_callback(ExtractionStatus.COMPLETED, 100)

        return ExtractionResult(
            extraction_id=extraction_id,
            status=ExtractionStatus.COMPLETED,
            source_type=request.source_type,
            document_type=request.document_type,
            processed_at=datetime.utcnow(),
            processing_time_seconds=round(processing_time, 2),
            total_input_tokens=sum(c.token_count for c in chunks),
            total_chunks=len(chunks),
            patterns=consolidated_patterns,
            frameworks=consolidated_frameworks,
            terminology=consolidated_terminology,
            knowledge_clusters=clusters,
            executive_summary=summary_data.get("summary", ""),
            key_themes=summary_data.get("key_themes", []),
            recommended_actions=summary_data.get("recommendations", [])
        )

    async def _extract_patterns(self, content: str) -> Dict[str, List]:
        """Extrae patrones de un chunk"""
        try:
            prompt = self.PATTERN_EXTRACTION_PROMPT.format(chunk_content=content[:8000])
            response = await self.llm.generate(self.EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
            data = self._parse_json_response(response)
            patterns = []
            for p in data.get("patterns", []):
                patterns.append(TechnicalPattern(
                    id=str(uuid.uuid4())[:8],
                    name=p.get("name", "Patrón sin nombre"),
                    category=PatternCategory(p.get("category", "technical")),
                    description=p.get("description", ""),
                    occurrences=1,
                    confidence=min(1.0, max(0.0, p.get("confidence", 0.5))),
                    examples=p.get("examples", [])[:5],
                    related_terms=p.get("related_terms", []),
                    context_snippets=p.get("context_snippets", [])[:3]
                ))
            return {"patterns": patterns}
        except Exception as e:
            return {"patterns": []}

    async def _extract_frameworks(self, content: str) -> Dict[str, List]:
        """Extrae frameworks de un chunk"""
        try:
            prompt = self.FRAMEWORK_EXTRACTION_PROMPT.format(chunk_content=content[:8000])
            response = await self.llm.generate(self.EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
            data = self._parse_json_response(response)
            frameworks = []
            for f in data.get("frameworks", []):
                frameworks.append(AnalyticalFramework(
                    id=str(uuid.uuid4())[:8],
                    name=f.get("name", "Framework sin nombre"),
                    description=f.get("description", ""),
                    components=f.get("components", []),
                    steps=f.get("steps"),
                    usage_examples=f.get("usage_examples", [])[:3],
                    implicit=f.get("implicit", True),
                    confidence=min(1.0, max(0.0, f.get("confidence", 0.5))),
                    source_evidence=f.get("source_evidence", [])[:3]
                ))
            return {"frameworks": frameworks}
        except Exception as e:
            return {"frameworks": []}

    async def _extract_terminology(self, content: str) -> Dict[str, List]:
        """Extrae terminología de un chunk"""
        try:
            prompt = self.TERMINOLOGY_EXTRACTION_PROMPT.format(chunk_content=content[:8000])
            response = await self.llm.generate(self.EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
            data = self._parse_json_response(response)
            terms = []
            for t in data.get("terminology", []):
                terms.append(TerminologyEntry(
                    term=t.get("term", ""),

                ))

    async def _extract_knowledge_clusters(self, chunks: List[TextChunk]) -> List[KnowledgeCluster]:
        """Genera clusters temáticos del contenido total"""
        try:
            # Crear resumen condensado de todos los chunks
            summaries = []
            for chunk in chunks[:20]:  # Limitar para no exceder tokens
                preview = chunk.content[:500]
                summaries.append(f"[Chunk {chunk.id}]: {preview}")

            combined = "\n\n---\n\n".join(summaries)

            prompt = self.CLUSTER_EXTRACTION_PROMPT.format(
                combined_text=combined[:12000]
            )
            response = await self.llm.generate(self.EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
            data = self._parse_json_response(response)

            clusters = []
            for c in data.get("clusters", []):
                clusters.append(KnowledgeCluster(

                    summary=c.get("summary", ""),
                    key_insights=c.get("key_insights", []),
                    related_patterns=[],
                    related_terms=[],
                    importance_score=min(1.0, max(0.0, c.get("importance_score", 0.5))),
                    source_chunks=[]
                ))
            return clusters
        except Exception:
            return []

        frameworks: List[AnalyticalFramework],
        terminology: List[TerminologyEntry],
        clusters: List[KnowledgeCluster],
        request: ExtractionRequest
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:

        try:
            context = f"""

- Patrones encontrados: {len(patterns)}
- Frameworks detectados: {len(frameworks)}
- Términos extraídos: {len(terminology)}
- Clusters temáticos: {len(clusters)}

TOP FRAMEWORKS: {', '.join(f.name for f in frameworks[:5])}
TOP TÉRMINOS: {', '.join(t.term for t in terminology[:10])}
TOP CLUSTERS: {', '.join(c.topic for c in clusters[:5])}

Tipo de documento objetivo: {request.document_type.value}
Áreas de enfoque: {request.focus_areas or 'General'}
"""
            prompt = f"""Basándote en estos resultados de extracción de conocimiento, genera:
1. Un resumen ejecutivo de 3-5 párrafos
2. Lista de temas clave (5-8 items)
3. Acciones recomendadas basadas en el conocimiento extraído (3-5 items)

{context}

Devuelve JSON: {{"summary": "...", "key_themes": [...], "recommendations": [...]}}"""

            response = await self.llm.generate(self.EXTRACTION_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
            return self._parse_json_response(response)
        except Exception:
            return {
                "summary": "Error generando resumen ejecutivo.",
                "key_themes": [],
                "recommendations": []
            }

    def _deduplicate_patterns(self, patterns: List[TechnicalPattern]) -> List[TechnicalPattern]:
        """Deduplica y consolida patrones similares"""
        seen = {}
        for p in patterns:
            key = p.name.lower().strip()
            if key in seen:
                existing = seen[key]
                existing.occurrences += 1
                existing.examples.extend(p.examples[:2])
                existing.confidence = max(existing.confidence, p.confidence)
                existing.context_snippets.extend(p.context_snippets[:1])
                # Deduplicar listas
                existing.examples = list(dict.fromkeys(existing.examples))[:8]
                existing.context_snippets = list(dict.fromkeys(existing.context_snippets))[:5]
            else:
                seen[key] = p
        return sorted(seen.values(), key=lambda x: x.confidence, reverse=True)

    def _deduplicate_frameworks(self, frameworks: List[AnalyticalFramework]) -> List[AnalyticalFramework]:
        """Deduplica frameworks similares"""
        seen = {}
        for f in frameworks:
            key = f.name.lower().strip()
            if key in seen:
                existing = seen[key]
                existing.confidence = max(existing.confidence, f.confidence)
                existing.usage_examples.extend(f.usage_examples[:2])
                existing.source_evidence.extend(f.source_evidence[:1])
                existing.usage_examples = list(dict.fromkeys(existing.usage_examples))[:5]
                existing.source_evidence = list(dict.fromkeys(existing.source_evidence))[:5]
            else:
                seen[key] = f
        return sorted(seen.values(), key=lambda x: x.confidence, reverse=True)

    def _deduplicate_terminology(self, terms: List[TerminologyEntry]) -> List[TerminologyEntry]:
        """Deduplica y cuenta frecuencia de términos"""
        seen = {}
        for t in terms:
            key = t.term.lower().strip()
            if key in seen:
                existing = seen[key]
                existing.frequency += 1
                existing.context_sentences.extend(t.context_sentences[:1])
                existing.context_sentences = list(dict.fromkeys(existing.context_sentences))[:5]
            else:
                seen[key] = t
        return sorted(seen.values(), key=lambda x: x.frequency, reverse=True)

    def _parse_json_response(self, response: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Parsea respuesta JSON del LLM con manejo de errores"""
        # Intentar extraer JSON de la respuesta
        response = response.strip()

        # Remover markdown code blocks si existen
        if response.startswith("```"):
            lines = response.split("\n")
            response = "\n".join(lines[1:-1] if lines[-1].strip() == "```" else lines[1:])

        try:
            return json.loads(response)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            # Intentar encontrar JSON en el texto
            import re
            json_match = re.search(r'\{[\s\S]*\}', response)
            if json_match:
                try:
                    return json.loads(json_match.group())
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    pass

            return {}

import re

from typing import List, Dict, Any, Tuple
from dataclasses import dataclass

    """

    con análisis cuantitativo de patrones recurrentes.

    # Patrones regex para estructuras comunes
    STRUCTURAL_PATTERNS = {
        "step_by_step": re.compile(
            r'(?:paso|step)\s*\d+|'
            r'(?:primero|segundo|tercero|cuarto|quinto|luego|después|finalmente)|'
            r'(?:1\.|2\.|3\.|4\.|5\.)',

        ),
        "pros_cons": re.compile(
            r'(?:pros?|ventajas?|beneficios?).*?(?:cons?|desventajas?|riesgos?)|'
            r'(?:por un lado|de un lado).*?(?:por otro|del otro)',
            re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL
        ),
        "root_cause": re.compile(
            r'(?:causa\s+ra[ií]z|root\s+cause|por\s+qu[eé]|5\s+por\s+qu[eé]s?|'
            r'problema\s+de\s+fondo|s[ií]ntoma|diagn[oó]stico)',
            re.IGNORECASE
        ),
        "comparison": re.compile(
            r'(?:comparado\s+con|versus|vs\.?|a\s+diferencia\s+de|'
            r'mejor\s+que|peor\s+que|en\s+comparaci[oó]n)',
            re.IGNORECASE
        ),
        "conditional_logic": re.compile(
            r'(?:si\s+.*?entonces|if\s+.*?then|en\s+caso\s+de|'
            r'si\s+.*?sino|cuando\s+.*?entonces)',
            re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL
        ),
        "hypothesis_testing": re.compile(
            r'(?:hip[oó]tesis|supongamos|asumamos|experimento|'
            r'verifiquemos|probemos|validemos)',
            re.IGNORECASE
        ),
        "iterative_process": re.compile(
            r'(?:iteraci[oó]n|refinamiento|versi[oó]n\s+\d|'
            r'ciclo\s+de|sprint|revisi[oó]n|mejora\s+continua)',
            re.IGNORECASE
        ),
        "trade_off": re.compile(
            r'(?:trade[\s-]?off|compensaci[oó]n|equilibrio|'
            r'costo[\s-]?beneficio|balance|sacrificio)',
            re.IGNORECASE
        ),
        "code_review": re.compile(
            r'(?:revisi[oó]n\s+de\s+c[oó]digo|code\s+review|'
            r'sugerencia|refactor|mejora\s+de|optimizar)',
            re.IGNORECASE
        ),
        "decision_matrix": re.compile(
            r'(?:criterio|criterios|ponderaci[oó]n|'
            r'matriz\s+de|puntuaci[oó]n|ranking|prioridad)',
            re.IGNORECASE
        )
    }

    CODE_PATTERNS = {
        "api_design": re.compile(
            r'(?:endpoint|REST|API|GET\s|POST\s|PUT\s|DELETE\s|'
            r'payload|request|response|status\s+code)',
            re.IGNORECASE
        ),
        "database": re.compile(
            r'(?:query|SQL|tabla|índice|JOIN|SELECT|'
            r'migraci[oó]n|schema|ORM|modelo)',

        ),
        "architecture": re.compile(

            r'CQRS|domain[\s-]?driven|hexagonal|clean\s+arch)',

        ),

            re.IGNORECASE
        )
    }

    def detect_structural_patterns(self, chunks_text: List[str]) -> List[StatisticalPattern]:
        """Detecta patrones estructurales en el texto"""
        results = []

        for pattern_name, regex in self.STRUCTURAL_PATTERNS.items():
            total_matches = 0
            evidence = []
            chunk_ids = []

            for i, text in enumerate(chunks_text):
                matches = regex.findall(text)
                if matches:
                    total_matches += len(matches)
                    chunk_ids.append(i)
                    # Extraer contexto
                    for match in regex.finditer(text):
                        start = max(0, match.start() - 40)
                        end = min(len(text), match.end() + 40)
                        evidence.append(f"...{text[start:end]}...")

            if total_matches >= 2:  # Mínimo para considerar patrón
                confidence = min(1.0, total_matches / 10)
                results.append(StatisticalPattern(
                    name=pattern_name.replace("_", " ").title(),
                    pattern_type="structural",
                    frequency=total_matches,
                    confidence=confidence,
                    evidence=evidence[:5],
                    related_chunks=chunk_ids
                ))

        return sorted(results, key=lambda x: x.frequency, reverse=True)

    def detect_code_patterns(self, chunks_text: List[str]) -> List[StatisticalPattern]:
        """Detecta patrones de dominio técnico"""
        results = []

        for pattern_name, regex in self.CODE_PATTERNS.items():
            total_matches = 0
            evidence = []
            chunk_ids = []

            for i, text in enumerate(chunks_text):
                matches = regex.findall(text)
                if matches:
                    total_matches += len(matches)
                    chunk_ids.append(i)
                    for match in regex.finditer(text):
                        start = max(0, match.start() - 30)
                        end = min(len(text), match.end() + 30)
                        evidence.append(f"...{text[start:end]}...")

            if total_matches >= 3:
                confidence = min(1.0, total_matches / 15)
                results.append(StatisticalPattern(
                    name=pattern_name.replace("_", " ").title(),
                    pattern_type="technical_domain",
                    frequency=total_matches,
                    confidence=confidence,
                    evidence=evidence[:5],
                    related_chunks=chunk_ids
                ))

        return sorted(results, key=lambda x: x.frequency, reverse=True)

    def detect_repetition_patterns(self, chunks_text: List[str],
                                    min_length: int = 10) -> List[StatisticalPattern]:
        """Detecta frases y conceptos repetidos"""
        # Extraer n-gramas significativos
        bigrams = Counter()
        trigrams = Counter()

        for text in chunks_text:
            words = re.findall(r'\b\w{3,}\b', text.lower())

            for i in range(len(words) - 1):
                bigrams[(words[i], words[i+1])] += 1
            for i in range(len(words) - 2):
                trigrams[(words[i], words[i+1], words[i+2])] += 1

        results = []

        # Bigramas frecuentes
        for (w1, w2), count in bigrams.most_common(20):
            if count >= 3:
                results.append(StatisticalPattern(
                    name=f"'{w1} {w2}'",
                    pattern_type="recurring_concept",
                    frequency=count,
                    confidence=min(1.0, count / 10),
                    evidence=[],
                    related_chunks=[]
                ))

        # Trigramas frecuentes
        for (w1, w2, w3), count in trigrams.most_common(15):
            if count >= 2:
                results.append(StatisticalPattern(
                    name=f"'{w1} {w2} {w3}'",
                    pattern_type="recurring_concept",
                    frequency=count,
                    confidence=min(1.0, count / 8),
                    evidence=[],
                    related_chunks=[]
                ))

        return results

    def analyze_conversation_dynamics(self, messages: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Analiza dinámicas de conversación en chats"""
        if not messages:
            return {}

        role_counts = Counter(m.get("role", "unknown") for m in messages)
        message_lengths = [len(m.get("content", "")) for m in messages]

        # Detectar turnos de pregunta-respuesta
        qa_pairs = 0
        for i in range(len(messages) - 1):
            if "?" in messages[i].get("content", ""):
                qa_pairs += 1

        # Detectar mensajes con código
        code_messages = sum(
            1 for m in messages
            if "```" in m.get("content", "")
        )

        return {
            "total_messages": len(messages),
            "role_distribution": dict(role_counts),
            "avg_message_length": sum(message_lengths) / max(1, len(message_lengths)),
            "max_message_length": max(message_lengths) if message_lengths else 0,
            "qa_pairs_detected": qa_pairs,
            "code_messages": code_messages,
            "code_ratio": code_messages / max(1, len(messages))
        }

@router.post("/upload-and-extract")
async def upload_and_extract(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    source_type: str = Form("mixed"),
    document_type: str = Form("knowledge_base"),
    focus_areas: Optional[str] = Form(None),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    """Sube archivo y ejecuta extracción completa"""
    # Validar archivo
    if not file.filename:
        raise HTTPException(400, "Nombre de archivo requerido")

    ext = os.path.splitext(file.filename)[1].lower()
    if ext not in settings.ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
        raise HTTPException(
            400,
            f"Extensión no permitida: {ext}. "
            f"Permitidas: {', '.join(settings.ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS)}"
        )

    # Leer contenido
    content = await file.read()
    if len(content) > settings.MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB * 1024 * 1024:
        raise HTTPException(413, f"Archivo excede {settings.MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB}MB")

    # Configurar request
    request = ExtractionRequest(
        source_type=SourceType(source_type),
        document_type=DocumentType(document_type),
        focus_areas=focus_areas.split(",") if focus_areas else None
    )

    try:
        # Ingesta
        chunks, stats = await ingestion_service.ingest_from_upload(
            content, file.filename, request
        )

        # Extracción
        provider = settings.DEFAULT_LLM_PROVIDER.value
        api_key = getattr(settings, f"{provider.upper()}_API_KEY")
        model = getattr(settings, f"{provider.upper()}_MODEL")

        llm_client = LLMClient(provider=provider, api_key=api_key, model=model)
        engine = ExtractionEngine(llm_client)
        await engine.initialize()

        result = await engine.extract_from_chunks(chunks, request)

        return {
            "extraction_id": result.extraction_id,
            "file_info": {
                "filename": file.filename,
                "size_bytes": len(content),
                "extension": ext
            },
            "ingest_stats": stats,
            "result": result
        }

    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(500, f"Error procesando archivo: {str(e)}")

    # Intentar parsear

    parse_error = None
    if is_valid and size_ok:
        try:

            text_preview = text[:500]

        "is_valid_format": is_valid,
        "is_valid_size": size_ok,
        "can_process": is_valid and size_ok and not parse_error,
        "text_preview": text_preview,
        "parse_error": parse_error,
        "estimated_chunks": max(1, len(content) // (settings.CHUNK_SIZE * 4))

import { ExtractionResult, ExtractionRequest, DocumentInfo, UploadValidation } from '../types';

const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8000';

class ApiClient {
  private baseUrl: string;

  constructor(baseUrl: string) {
    this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
  }

  private async request<T>(endpoint: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
    const url = `${this.baseUrl}${endpoint}`;
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...options.headers,
      },
      ...options,
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      const error = await response.json().catch(() => ({ detail: response.statusText }));
      throw new Error(error.detail || `HTTP ${response.status}`);
    }

    return response.json();
  }

  // ── Extracción ──

  async extractFromText(
    content: string,
    request: ExtractionRequest
  ): Promise<ExtractionResult> {
    return this.request<ExtractionResult>('/api/v1/extraction/text', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ text_input: { content }, request }),
    });
  }

  async extractFromChat(
    messages: Array<{ role: string; content: string }>,
    request: ExtractionRequest,
    platform?: string
  ): Promise<ExtractionResult> {
    return this.request<ExtractionResult>('/api/v1/extraction/chat', {

        request,

    });

    sourceType: string,
    documentType: string,

    formData.append('source_type', sourceType);
    formData.append('document_type', documentType);
    if (focusAreas) formData.append('focus_areas', focusAreas);

    const response = await fetch(
      `${this.baseUrl}/api/v1/ingestion/upload-and-extract`,
      { method: 'POST', body: formData }
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
      const error = await response.json().catch(() => ({ detail: 'Upload failed' }));

    }

    return response.json();
  }

      method: 'POST',
      body: formData,

import { api } from '../services/api';
import { ExtractionResult, ExtractionRequest, ExtractionStatus } from '../types';

interface UseExtractionState {
  status: ExtractionStatus;
  progress: number;
  result: ExtractionResult | null;
  error: string | null;
  isProcessing: boolean;
}

const DEFAULT_REQUEST: ExtractionRequest = {
  source_type: 'mixed',
  document_type: 'knowledge_base',
  language: 'es',
  include_code_snippets: true,
  extract_frameworks: true,
  extract_terminology: true,
  extract_patterns: true,
};

export function useExtraction() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<UseExtractionState>({
    status: 'pending',
    progress: 0,
    result: null,
    error: null,
    isProcessing: false,
  });

  const extractFromText = useCallback(async (
    text: string,
    request: Partial<ExtractionRequest> = {}
  ) => {
    setState({ status: 'ingesting', progress: 10, result: null, error: null, isProcessing: true });

    try {
      const fullRequest = { ...DEFAULT_REQUEST, ...request };
      setState(s => ({ ...s, status: 'chunking', progress: 20 }));

      // Simular progreso (el backend no envía SSE en esta versión)
      const progressInterval = setInterval(() => {
        setState(s => ({
          ...s,
          progress: Math.min(s.progress + 5, 90),
          status: s.progress < 40 ? 'extracting' : s.progress < 70 ? 'analyzing' : 'generating',
        }));
      }, 2000);

      const result = await api.extractFromText(text, fullRequest);

      clearInterval(progressInterval);
      setState({ status: 'completed', progress: 100, result, error: null, isProcessing: false });
      return result;
    } catch (err: any) {
      setState(s => ({ ...s, status: 'failed', error: err.message, isProcessing: false }));
      throw err;
    }
  }, []);

  const extractFromFile = useCallback(async (
    file: File,
    request: Partial<ExtractionRequest> = {}
  ) => {
    setState({ status: 'ingesting', progress: 10, result: null, error: null, isProcessing: true });

    try {
      const progressInterval = setInterval(() => {
        setState(s => ({
          ...s,
          progress: Math.min(s.progress + 3, 90),
          status: s.progress < 30 ? 'ingesting' : s.progress < 60 ? 'extracting' : 'analyzing',
        }));
      }, 2000);

      const response = await api.uploadAndExtract(
        file,
        request.source_type || 'mixed',
        request.document_type || 'knowledge_base'
      );

      clearInterval(progressInterval);
      setState({
        status: 'completed',
        progress: 100,
        result: response.result,
        error: null,
        isProcessing: false,
      });
      return response.result;
    } catch (err: any) {
      setState(s => ({ ...s, status: 'failed', error: err.message, isProcessing: false }));
      throw err;
    }
  }, []);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setState({ status: 'pending', progress: 0, result: null, error: null, isProcessing: false });
  }, []);

  return { ...state, extractFromText, extractFromFile, reset };
}

import React from 'react';

import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface Props {
  status: ExtractionStatus;
  progress: number;
}

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<ExtractionStatus, { label: string; icon: string; color: string }> = {
  pending: { label: 'Esperando...', icon: '⏳', color: 'bg-gray-400' },
  ingesting: { label: 'Ingestando datos...', icon: '📥', color: 'bg-blue-500' },
  chunking: { label: 'Segmentando texto...', icon: '✂️', color: 'bg-blue-500' },
  extracting: { label: 'Extrayendo conocimiento...', icon: '🔍', color: 'bg-purple-500' },
  analyzing: { label: 'Analizando patrones...', icon: '📊', color: 'bg-orange-500' },
  generating: { label: 'Generando documento...', icon: '📝', color: 'bg-green-500' },
  completed: { label: '¡Completado!', icon: '✅', color: 'bg-green-500' },
  failed: { label: 'Error', icon: '❌', color: 'bg-red-500' },
};

export default function ProcessingProgress({ status, progress }: Props) {
  const info = STATUS_LABELS[status];

  if (status === 'pending') return null;

  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border p-6 space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        {status !== 'completed' && status !== 'failed' ? (
          <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-blue-500" />
        ) : (
          <span className="text-2xl">{info.icon}</span>
        )}
        <div className="flex-1">
          <p className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{info.label}</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">{progress}% completado</p>
        </div>
        <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{progress}%</span>
      </div>

      {/* Progress Bar */}
      <div className="h-3 bg-gray-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
        <div
          className={`h-full ${info.color} rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ease-out`}
          style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Phase indicators */}
      <div className="flex justify-between text-xs text-gray-400">
        {['Ingesta', 'Chunking', 'Extracción', 'Análisis', 'Documento'].map((phase, i) => {
          const phaseProgress = i * 20;
          const isActive = progress >= phaseProgress && progress < phaseProgress + 25;
          const isDone = progress >= phaseProgress + 20;

          return (
            <span
              key={phase}
              className={`${isDone ? 'text-green-600 font-medium' : isActive ? 'text-blue-600 font-medium' : ''}`}
            >
              {isDone ? '✓' : isActive ? '●' : '○'} {phase}
            </span>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface Props {

    .sort((a, b) => sortBy === 'confidence' ? b.confidence - a.confidence : b.occurrences - a.occurrences);

                className="w-full text-left p-4 flex items-center justify-between"

                  <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{pattern.name}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <div className="w-20 h-2 bg-gray-200 rounded-full overflow-hidden">

                    <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{Math.round(pattern.confidence * 100)}%</span>
