```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '../services/api';
import { Download, FileText, Code, FileJson, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface Props {
  extractionId: string;
}

type Format = 'markdown' | 'react' | 'json';

export default function ExportPanel({ extractionId }: Props) {
  const [selectedFormat, setSelectedFormat] = useState<Format>('markdown');
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [generatedContent, setGeneratedContent] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const formats: { id: Format; label: string; description: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[] = [
    {
      id: 'markdown',
      label: 'Markdown',
      description: 'Documento Markdown listo para GitHub, Notion o cualquier editor',
      icon: <FileText className="w-6 h-6" />,
    },
    {
      id: 'react',
      label: 'React Artifact',
      description: 'Componente React/TSX interactivo para embeber en aplicaciones',
      icon: <Code className="w-6 h-6" />,
    },
    {
      id: 'json',
      label: 'JSON',
      description: 'Datos estructurados para integración con APIs y pipelines',
      icon: <FileJson className="w-6 h-6" />,
    },
  ];

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    setIsGenerating(true);
    setError(null);
    setGeneratedContent(null);

    try {
      const response = await api.generateDocument(extractionId, selectedFormat);
      setGeneratedContent(response.content);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (!generatedContent) return;

    const extensions: Record<Format, string> = {
      markdown: 'md',
      react: 'tsx',
      json: 'json',
    };

    const mimeTypes: Record<Format, string> = {
      markdown: 'text/markdown',
      react: 'text/javascript',
      json: 'application/json',
    };

    const blob = new Blob([generatedContent], { type: mimeTypes[selectedFormat] });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `knowledge-extraction-${extractionId.slice(0, 8)}.${extensions[selectedFormat]}`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    if (generatedContent) {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(generatedContent);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Format Selection */}
      <div>
        <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 mb-3">Selecciona formato de exportación</h3>
        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {formats.map((format) => (
            <button
              key={format.id}
              onClick={() => { setSelectedFormat(format.id); setGeneratedContent(null); }}
              className={`p-4 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all ${
                selectedFormat === format.id
                  ? 'border-blue-500 bg-blue-50 ring-2 ring-blue-200'
                  : 'border-gray-200 hover:border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50'
              }`}
            >
              <div className={`mb-2 ${selectedFormat === format.id ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>
                {format.icon}
              </div>
              <h4 className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{format.label}</h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">{format.description}</p>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Generate Button */}
      <button
        onClick={handleGenerate}
        disabled={isGenerating}
        className="w-full py-3 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-xl font-medium hover:bg-blue-700 disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-colors"
      >
        {isGenerating ? (
          <>
            <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" />
            Generando documento...
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Download className="w-5 h-5" />
            Generar {formats.find(f => f.id === selectedFormat)?.label}
          </>
        )}
      </button>

      {/* Error */}
      {error && (
        <div className="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl p-4 text-red-700 text-sm">
          Error: {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Preview */}
      {generatedContent && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900">Vista previa</h3>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={handleCopy}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-gray-200 transition-colors"
              >
                📋 Copiar
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleDownload}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-200 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                <Download className="w-4 h-4" /> Descargar
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <pre className="bg-gray-900 text-green-400 p-4 rounded-xl overflow-auto max-h-96 text-xs leading-relaxed">
            {generatedContent.slice(0, 5000)}
            {generatedContent.length > 5000 && '\n\n... (truncado para vista previa)'}
          </pre>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 text-center">
            {generatedContent.length.toLocaleString()} caracteres · {generatedContent.split(/\s+/).length.toLocaleString()} palabras
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

---

### 📂 1. Archivos de Configuración Previos

Antes de construir, asegúrate de tener estos archivos base en tu proyecto.

#### `backend/.env.example` (Renombra a `.env` y rellena)

#### `frontend/nginx.conf` (Para el contenedor de producción)
```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name localhost;

    # Servir archivos estáticos de React
    location / {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        index index.html;
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }

    # Proxy hacia el Backend
    location /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://backend:8000/;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    }
}
```

---

### 🐳 OPCIÓN A: Build Completo con Docker (Recomendado)

Esta opción compila el backend en Python y el frontend en React (usando Nginx para servir los estáticos) y los conecta.

#### 1. Actualiza los `Dockerfile`s

**`backend/Dockerfile`**
```dockerfile
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
# Instalar dependencias del sistema si fueran necesarias
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
```

**`frontend/Dockerfile`** (Multi-stage build para producción)
```dockerfile
# Etapa 1: Construir React
FROM node:20-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
# Asegurar que la API apunte a /api en producción
ENV VITE_API_URL=/api
RUN npm run build

# Etapa 2: Servir con Nginx
FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
```

#### 2. Actualiza `docker-compose.yml`
```yaml
version: '3.8'

services:
  backend:
    build: ./backend
    container_name: knex-backend
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    env_file: 
      - ./backend/.env
    restart: unless-stopped

  frontend:
    build: ./frontend
    container_name: knex-frontend
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    depends_on:
      - backend
    restart: unless-stopped
```

#### 3. ¡Construir y Levantar!
Ejecuta estos comandos en la raíz del proyecto:
```bash
# Copiar y configurar variables de entorno
cp backend/.env.example backend/.env
# (Edita backend/.env con tu API Key)

# Construir imágenes y levantar servicios en background
docker compose up --build -d

# Ver logs en tiempo real
docker compose logs -f
```
🎉 **Listo.** Abre tu navegador en `http://localhost`. Nginx servirá la UI y enrutarás las peticiones a `/api/extract` al backend automáticamente.

---

### 💻 OPCIÓN B: Build Nativo (Para Desarrollo Local)

Si prefieres no usar Docker y correrlo directamente en tu sistema operativo.

#### 1. Script Automatizado de Build (`build.sh` para Mac/Linux o `build.bat` para Windows)

Crea un archivo `build.sh` en la raíz del proyecto:

```bash

echo "🚀 Iniciando build nativo de KNEX..."

# --- BACKEND ---
echo "📦 Configurando Backend..."
cd backend
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install -r requirements.txt
cd ..

# --- FRONTEND ---
echo "📦 Configurando Frontend..."
cd frontend
npm install
npm run build
cd ..

echo "✅ Build completado. Para ejecutar en modo desarrollo:"
echo "   Backend: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && uvicorn main:app --reload"
echo "   Frontend: cd frontend && npm run dev"
```

```bat

echo 🚀 Iniciando build nativo de KNEX...

echo 📦 Configurando Backend...
cd backend
python -m venv .venv
call .venv\Scripts\activate.bat

pip install -r requirements.txt
cd ..

echo 📦 Configurando Frontend...
cd frontend
npm install
npm run build
cd ..

echo ✅ Build completado.
```

#### 2. Ejecutar en Modo Desarrollo (Hot-Reload)

Abre **dos terminales** distintas:

**Terminal 1 (Backend):**
```bash

source .venv/bin/activate  # En Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate

```

```bash

```

# 🧠 Motor de Extracción y Estructuración de Conocimiento No Estructurado (KNEX) Producto completo que ingiere historiales de chat, correos y transcripciones masivas, extrae patrones técnicos, frameworks analíticos implícitos y terminología, y genera documentos formateados listos para portfolios, casos de estudio o manuales empresariales. --- ## 📦 Estructura del proyecto ``` knex/ ├── backend/ │ ├── main.py │ ├── ingestor.py │ ├── extractor.py │ ├── structurer.py │ ├── exporter.py │ ├── models.py │ └── requirements.txt ├── frontend/ │ ├── src/App.jsx │ ├── src/main.jsx │ ├── python-multipart==0.0.9 pydantic==2.6.4 openai==1.23.0 tiktoken==0.6.0 python-dotenv==1.0.1 httpx==0.27.0 chardet==5.2.0 beautifulsoup4==4.12.3 ``` ### `backend/models.py` ```python from __future__ import annotations from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional from enum import Enum class SourceType(str, Enum): CHAT_EXPORT = "chat_export" EMAIL = "email" TRANSCRIPT = "transcript" RAW_TEXT = "raw_text" class ExportFormat(str, Enum): MARKDOWN = "markdown" REACT_ARTIFACT = "react_artifact" JSON = "json" class ExtractedPattern(BaseModel): name: str = Field(..., description="Nombre del patrón detectado") category: str = Field(..., description="Categoría: técnico, metodológico, comunicacional") description: str evidence: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list) frequency: int = 1 relevance: float = Field(..., ge=0, le=1) class ExtractedFramework(BaseModel): name: str structure: Dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict) steps: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list) inferred_from: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list) abstraction_level: str = Field(..., description="táctico | estratégico | conceptual") class TerminologyEntry(BaseModel): term: str definition: str domain: str usage_examples: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list) is_jargon: bool = False class KnowledgeGraph(BaseModel): title: str summary: str patterns: List[ExtractedPattern] = Field(default_factory=list) frameworks: List[ExtractedFramework] = Field(default_factory=list) terminology: List[TerminologyEntry] = Field(default_factory=list) key_insights: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list) audience_suggestion: str = "" use_case_tags: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list) class ExtractionRequest(BaseModel): source_type: SourceType target_format: ExportFormat = ExportFormat.MARKDOWN language: str = "es" focus: Optional[str] = None # "técnico", "gestión", "pedagógico" max_tokens_context: int = 16000 class ExtractionResponse(BaseModel): graph: KnowledgeGraph artifact: str # Markdown o código React stats: Dict[str, Any] ``` ### `backend/ingestor.py` ```python """ Ingestor: normaliza fuentes heterogéneas a una representación uniforme de mensajes/turnos con metadatos. """ import re, json, csv, io, email from dataclasses import dataclass, field from typing import List, Optional from bs4 import BeautifulSoup @dataclass class Message: role: str # "user" | "assistant" | "system" | "human" content: str timestamp: Optional[str] = None author: Optional[str] = None meta: dict = field(default_factory=dict) # --- Detectores de formato ---------------------------------------------------- _WHATSAPP_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*\[?(\d{1,2}[/-]\d{1,2}[/-]\d{2,4}[,\s]+\d{1,2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?(?:\s?[APap][Mm])?)\]?\s*[-–]?\s*([^:]+):\s*(.*)$") _SLACK_JSON_KEYS = {"user", "text", "ts"} _CSV_CHAT_KEYS = {"role", "content", "message", "author"} def detect_and_ingest(raw_text: str, filename: str = "") -> List[Message]: """Detecta el formato y devuelve mensajes normalizados.""" text = raw_text.strip() if not text: return [] # 1) JSON de Slack / export genérico if text.startswith("[") or text.startswith("{"): try: data = json.loads(text) return _ingest_json(data) except json.JSONDecodeError: pass # 2) CSV con columnas role/content if "\n" in text and ("," in text.splitlines()[0] or "\t" in text.splitlines()[0]): msgs = _try_csv(text) if msgs: return msgs # 3) Email RFC822 if text.lower().startswith(("from:", "received:", "return-path:")) or "\nfrom:" in text.lower()[:500]: return _ingest_email(text) # 4) Export WhatsApp / Telegram estilo "fecha - autor: texto" wa = _ingest_whatsapp_style(text) if wa: return wa # 5) Transcript con "User:" / "Assistant:" / "Human:" turn = _ingest_turn_based(text) if turn: return turn # 6) Fallback: un solo bloque de texto return [Message(role="user", content=text, author="source")] def _ingest_json(data) -> List[Message]: out: List[Message] = [] items = data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get("messages", [data]) for item in items: if not isinstance(item, dict): continue role = item.get("role") or item.get("speaker") or item.get("from") or "user" content = item.get("content") or item.get("text") or item.get("body") or "" if isinstance(content, list): # OpenAI multimodal content = " ".join( p.get("text", "") if isinstance(p, dict) else str(p) for p in content ) if not content: continue out.append(Message( role=str(role).lower(), content=str(content), timestamp=item.get("ts") or item.get("timestamp") or item.get("date"), author=item.get("user") or item.get("author") or item.get("name"), )) return out def _try_csv(text: str) -> List[Message]: try: sample = text[:2048] dialect = csv.Sniffer().sniff(sample, delimiters=",;\t|") reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text), dialect=dialect) if not reader.fieldnames: return [] lower = {f.lower() for f in reader.fieldnames} if not (_CSV_CHAT_KEYS & lower): return [] out = [] for row in reader: r = {k.lower(): v for k, v in row.items() if v} content = r.get("content") or r.get("message") or r.get("text") or "" role = r.get("role") or r.get("speaker") or "user" if content: out.append(Message(role=str(role).lower(), content=content, author=r.get("author") or r.get("user"))) return out except Exception: return [] def _ingest_email(text: str) -> List[Message]: try: msg = email.message_from_string(text) body = "" if msg.is_multipart(): for part in msg.walk(): if part.get_content_type() == "text/plain": payload = part.get_payload(decode=True) if payload: body = payload.decode(errors="ignore") break else: body = msg.get_payload(decode=True).decode(errors="ignore") if msg.get_payload() else "" soup = BeautifulSoup(body, "html.parser") clean = soup.get_text(separator="\n", strip=True) or body return [Message(role="user", content=clean, author=msg.get("From"), timestamp=msg.get("Date"), meta={"subject": msg.get("Subject")})] except Exception: return [] def _ingest_whatsapp_style(text: str) -> List[Message]: out = [] for line in text.splitlines(): m = _WHATSAPP_RE.match(line) if m: ts, author, content = m.groups() out.append(Message(role="user", content=content.strip(), timestamp=ts.strip(), author=author.strip())) return out def _ingest_turn_based(text: str) -> List[Message]: turn_re = re.compile(r"^(User|Assistant|Human|AI|System|Bot|Me)\s*:\s*(.*)$", re.IGNORECASE) out = [] current_role, current_buf = None, [] for line in text.splitlines(): m = turn_re.match(line.strip()) if m: if current_role is not None: out.append(Message(role=current_role, content="\n".join(current_buf).strip())) current_role = m.group(1).lower() if current_role in {"human", "me"}: current_role = "user" if current_role == "bot": current_role = "assistant" current_buf = [m.group(2)] else: if current_role is not None: current_buf.append(line) if current_role is not None and current_buf: Debes ser CONCRETO, citar evidencia textual corta entre comillas, y evitar inventar. Si no hay suficiente información para una categoría, devuelve []. Responde SIEMPRE en JSON válido con esta forma: { "title": "...", "summary": "...", "patterns": [{"name":"","category":"","description":"","evidence":[""],"frequency":1,"relevance":0.0}], "frameworks": [{"name":"","structure":{},"steps":[],"inferred_from":[""],"abstraction_level":""}], "terminology": [{"term":"","definition":"","domain":"","usage_examples":[],"is_jargon":false}], "key_insights": [], "audience_suggestion": "", "use_case_tags": [] } """ def _build_client() -> OpenAI: return OpenAI( api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "sk-placeholder"), base_url=os.getenv("OPENAI_BASE_URL"), # permite Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM, etc. ) def extract(text: str, focus: str | None, language: str = "es", model: str | None = None) -> KnowledgeGraph: client = _build_client() model = model or os.getenv("KNEX_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini") focus_hint = f"\nFoco solicitado por el usuario: {focus}." if focus else "" user_msg = ( f"Idioma de salida: {language}.{focus_hint}\n\n" f"=== TEXTO A ANALIZAR ===\n{text}\n=== FIN ===" ) resp = client.chat.completions.create( model=model, messages=[ {"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT}, {"role": "user", "content": user_msg}, ], temperature=0.2, response_format={"type": "json_object"}, ) raw = resp.choices[0].message.content or "{}" data = json.loads(raw) return KnowledgeGraph( title=data.get("title", "Sin título"), summary=data.get("summary", ""), patterns=[ExtractedPattern(**p) for p in data.get("patterns", [])], frameworks=[ExtractedFramework(**f) for f in data.get("frameworks", [])], terminology=[TerminologyEntry(**t) for t in data.get("terminology", [])], key_insights=data.get("key_insights", []), audience_suggestion=data.get("audience_suggestion", ""), use_case_tags=data.get("use_case_tags", []), ) ``` ### `backend/structurer.py` ```python """ Structurer: organiza el KnowledgeGraph en secciones narrativas según el tipo de documento objetivo (caso de estudio, portfolio, manual). ".join(f'"{e}"' for e in f.inferred_from)) body.append("") sections.append({"heading": "Marcos analíticos implícitos", "level": 2, "body": "\n".join(body)}) # 4) Patrones if graph.patterns: body = [] for p in sorted(graph.patterns, key=lambda x: -x.relevance): body.append(f"- **{p.name}** _({p.category})_ — {p.description}") if p.evidence: body.append(" - Evidencia: " + "; Para compilar y desplegar **todo el proyecto KNEX** (Backend + Frontend + Infraestructura), te proporciono las instrucciones completas. 

Tienes dos opciones: **Opción A (Docker / Producción)** que levanta todo con un solo comando, y **Opción B (Local / Desarrollo)** para correrlo nativamente en tu máquina.

---

### 📂 1. Archivos de Configuración Previos

Antes de construir, asegúrate de tener estos archivos base en tu proyecto.

#### `backend/.env.example` (Renombra a `.env` y rellena)
```env
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-tu-clave-aqui
OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://api.openai.com/v1
KNEX_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini
```

#### `frontend/nginx.conf` (Para el contenedor de producción)
```nginx
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name localhost;

    # Servir archivos estáticos de React
    location / {
        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        index index.html;
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }

    # Proxy hacia el Backend
    location /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://backend:8000/;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    }
}
```

---

### 🐳 OPCIÓN A: Build Completo con Docker (Recomendado)

Esta opción compila el backend en Python y el frontend en React (usando Nginx para servir los estáticos) y los conecta.

#### 1. Actualiza los `Dockerfile`s

**`backend/Dockerfile`**
```dockerfile
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
# Instalar dependencias del sistema si fueran necesarias
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
```

**`frontend/Dockerfile`** (Multi-stage build para producción)
```dockerfile
# Etapa 1: Construir React
FROM node:20-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
# Asegurar que la API apunte a /api en producción
ENV VITE_API_URL=/api
RUN npm run build

# Etapa 2: Servir con Nginx
FROM nginx:alpine
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
```

#### 2. Actualiza `docker-compose.yml`
```yaml
version: '3.8'

services:
  backend:
    build: ./backend
    container_name: knex-backend
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    env_file: 
      - ./backend/.env
    restart: unless-stopped

  frontend:
    build: ./frontend
    container_name: knex-frontend
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    depends_on:
      - backend
    restart: unless-stopped
```

#### 3. ¡Construir y Levantar!
Ejecuta estos comandos en la raíz del proyecto:
```bash
# Copiar y configurar variables de entorno
cp backend/.env.example backend/.env
# (Edita backend/.env con tu API Key)

# Construir imágenes y levantar servicios en background
docker compose up --build -d

# Ver logs en tiempo real
docker compose logs -f
```
🎉 **Listo.** Abre tu navegador en `http://localhost`. Nginx servirá la UI y enrutarás las peticiones a `/api/extract` al backend automáticamente.

---

### 💻 OPCIÓN B: Build Nativo (Para Desarrollo Local)

Si prefieres no usar Docker y correrlo directamente en tu sistema operativo.

#### 1. Script Automatizado de Build (`build.sh` para Mac/Linux o `build.bat` para Windows)

Crea un archivo `build.sh` en la raíz del proyecto:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
echo "🚀 Iniciando build nativo de KNEX..."

# --- BACKEND ---
echo "📦 Configurando Backend..."
cd backend
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install -r requirements.txt
cd ..

# --- FRONTEND ---
echo "📦 Configurando Frontend..."
cd frontend
npm install
npm run build
cd ..

echo "✅ Build completado. Para ejecutar en modo desarrollo:"
echo "   Backend: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && uvicorn main:app --reload"
echo "   Frontend: cd frontend && npm run dev"
```
*Nota: Si estás en Windows, usa este `build.bat`:*
```bat
@echo off
echo 🚀 Iniciando build nativo de KNEX...

echo 📦 Configurando Backend...
cd backend
python -m venv .venv
call .venv\Scripts\activate.bat
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install -r requirements.txt
cd ..

echo 📦 Configurando Frontend...
cd frontend
npm install
npm run build
cd ..

echo ✅ Build completado.
```

#### 2. Ejecutar en Modo Desarrollo (Hot-Reload)

Abre **dos terminales** distintas:

**Terminal 1 (Backend):**
```bash
cd backend
source .venv/bin/activate  # En Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate
uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
```

**Terminal 2 (Frontend):**
```bash
cd frontend
npm run dev
```
🎉 **Listo.** El frontend estará en `http://localhost:5173` y el proxy de Vite enviará las peticiones `/api` al backend en el puerto `8000`.

---

### 🧪 3. Verificación y Pruebas (Testing el Build)

Una vez que la aplicación esté corriendo (vía Docker o Local), verifica que todo esté integrado:

**1. Healthcheck del Backend:**
```bash
curl http://localhost:8000/health
# Debería devolver: {"ok":true,"model":"gpt-4o-mini"}
```

**2. Prueba de Ingestión (Preview sin LLM):**

```text
Assistant: Perfecto. Apliquemos el patrón Strangler Fig para migrar por bordes.
```

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/preview \
  -F "file=@test_chat.txt" \
  -F "max_tokens_context=4000"
```

**3. Extracción Completa (Generando el Artefacto):**
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/extract \
  -F "file=@test_chat.txt" \
  -F "source_type=raw_text" \
  -F "target_format=markdown" \
  -F "language=es" \
  -F "focus=técnico"
```

*Esto devolverá el JSON con el `KnowledgeGraph` y el `artifact` en Markdown listo para copiar y pegar en tu portfolio o Notion.*
